chinese: 嗨，彼得。你的周末过得怎么样？
english: Hi, Peter. How was your weekend?

chinese: 很棒！我去参观了科学博物馆。
english: It was great! I visited the science museum.

chinese: 你看到什么有趣的东西了吗？
是的，那里有一个太空展览。
english: Yes, there was a space exhibition.

chinese: 它们看起来像空间站的一部分。
english: and they looked like parts of a space station.

chinese: 你可以走进去，看看宇航员是如何生活和工作的！
english: You could go inside them and see how astronauts live and work!
Cool! Were there any astronauts there?
Well, no. But there were robots!

chinese: 我向其中一个提问，它还回答我了！
english: I asked one of them questions and it answered me!

chinese: 哇！我也好想去看看它们。
english: Wow! I’d love to go and see them.
